d: We are seeking an experienced EDR Platform Engineer-Elastic Security to administer, operate, maintain, and enhance an enterprise Elastic Security and Endpoint Detection & Response environment. The ideal candidate combines strong hands-on Elastic expertise with solid cybersecurity knowledge and advanced Linux administration and troubleshooting skills.

Ensure the organization’s Elastic Security platform and endpoint protection infrastructure remain secure, stable, highly available, scalable, and operationally effective while continuously improving security visibility, detection capability, endpoint coverage, and incident-response readiness
q: Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting capability is essential for this position.
 RHEL, Alma Linux, Ubuntu, or similar enterprise Linux distributions.
 Linux command-line administration, systemd/systemctl, journalctl, and operating-system log analysis.
 File systems, mounts, permissions, ownership, users, groups, sudo, and access controls.
 CPU, memory, disk, process, network, DNS, TCP/IP, SSH, and connectivity troubleshooting.
 Firewall administration, SELinux, RPM/YUM/DNF/APT package management, and Bash scripting (preferred)
 Ability to diagnose production issues directly from the Linux command line and perform structured root-cause analysis.
 Strong hands-on experience with Elastic Stack: Elasticsearch, Kibana, Elastic Security, Elastic Defend, Elastic Agent, Fleet/Fleet Server, and Logstash.
 Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills and good understanding of Windows endpoint security.
 Cybersecurity fundamentals, SIEM/EDR operations, security-event analysis, and incident-response management.
 Elastic Cloud Enterprise (ECE), distributed/multi-cluster Elastic architectures, high availability, and disaster recovery.
 Elasticsearch snapshot/restore, load balancers, reverse proxies, VMware or other virtualization platforms.
 Ansible or similar configuration-management tools, Git, REST APIs, and Python scripting.
 Approximately 3–5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, security engineering, infrastructure security, SIEM, EDR, or related technical roles.
 Hands-on production experience administering Elastic Stack environments and troubleshooting complex Linux-based systems.
 Experience operating EDR or endpoint-security technologies in enterprise and high-availability and critical infrastructure environment.
 Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Information Security or equivalent professional experience.
 Candidates with strong Elastic and Linux expertise but fewer total years of experience may also be considered.
 Elastic Certified Engineer, Elastic Certified Analyst, or relevant Elastic certification (preferred)
 CompTIA Security+ / CySA+ or equivalent certification
 GIAC, CISSP, or equivalent security certification (preferred)
 Strong technical troubleshooting, analytical thinking, and structured root-cause analysis.
 Ability to troubleshoot across endpoint, network, operating-system, ingestion, and Elasticsearch layers.
 Ability to work effectively during critical production infrastructure and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 Strong documentation skills and ability to work independently and collaboratively across technical teams.
r:  Administer and maintain Elastic Security and Elastic Defend (EDR) environments.
 Deploy, configure, upgrade, and troubleshoot Elastic Agent on Linux and Windows endpoints.
 Manage Elastic Agent centrally through Fleet and Fleet Server, including agent policies, integrations, and endpoint policies.
 Monitor agent health, connectivity, policy status, telemetry, and data ingestion; troubleshoot offline, unhealthy, or degraded agents.
 Configure EDR prevention, detection, response, endpoint isolation, and other response capabilities.
 Manage large-scale EDR deployment across enterprise servers and workstations and execute upgrades with minimal disruption.
 Coordinate upgrades, patches, configuration changes, technical documentation, troubleshooting procedures, and operational run-books.
 Work closely with SOC analysts, infrastructure, network, systems, and cybersecurity teams; coordinate with vendors when escalation is required.
 Administer Elasticsearch clusters supporting Elastic Security and monitor cluster/node health, shard allocation, indexing, disk and resource utilization.
 Troubleshoot cluster, node, index, shard, authentication, authorization, connectivity, and performance issues.
 Manage index templates, component templates, data streams, ILM policies, retention, users, roles, privileges, API keys, and certificates.
 Administer Kibana and Elastic Security applications and support snapshot, restore, backup, and disaster-recovery procedures.
 Administer and troubleshoot Logstash pipelines, including inputs, filters, outputs, and data ingestion.
 Investigate delayed, dropped, duplicated events and identify ingestion bottlenecks.
 Work with Elastic Agent integrations, Beats, Syslog, APIs, ingest pipelines, ECS, and related parsing/normalization technologies.
 Configure, maintain, and tune Elastic Security detection rules to improve coverage and reduce false positives.
 Create custom detections based on organizational threats and use cases using KQL, EQL, ES|QL, and Elasticsearch Query DSL.
 Apply process whitelisting\block-listing following the best practice approach.

d: 负责公司在中东国家的本地法律事务，确保公司业务合规运营。
起草、审核、翻译中英文合同、协议及法律文件，协助业务部门处理各类法律问题。
处理日常法务咨询、合规检查、政府问询沟通等事项。
协助建立和完善子公司合规体系、法律风险防控机制，落实总部合规制度政策。与本地法务和全球法务团队协作，确保跨司法管辖区法律框架和合规标准的一致性。
开发、维护外部律师、律所及其他法律服务供应商资源池。
支持公司内部培训、法律宣传及员工合规意识提升。
法律相关专业本科及以上学历。
7年以上涉外业务法务工作经验 ，有跨境法律事务处理背景或有英语国家海外教育经历。
英语流利 ，具备法律文件中英双语起草、翻译和沟通能力。
具备分析能力、解决问题能力以及向非法律人员解释复杂法律问题的能力。
熟悉政府调查流程，有政府沟通能力及政府调查、问询应对经验，能够处理政府合规、调查等相关事务。
良好的沟通协调能力、团队合作精神及跨文化适应能力。
工作细致严谨，责任心强，能承受一定工作压力、在快节奏环境中管理复杂法律项目，乐于接受新鲜事物、迎接挑战。
有互联网、平台、物流、仓储、外卖等行业法务经验者优先。
有科威特或卡塔尔工作经历优先。
具有中国或其他国家法律执业资格优先。

We are looking for an experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O) HR Techno-Functional Consultant with 5–7 years of hands-on experience in implementing, customizing, configuring, and supporting HR and Payroll modules.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of HR business processes, payroll operations, employee lifecycle management, performance appraisal processes, and the ability to translate business requirements into functional and technical solutions within Dynamics 365 F&O.
q: Understand and configure employee performance management and appraisal processes.
Implement and support performance evaluation cycles, objectives, KPIs, competency assessments, and employee reviews.
Configure appraisal workflows, evaluation criteria, and performance ratings.
Support the integration of performance management processes with broader HR operations.
Conduct business requirement gathering and fit-gap analysis.
Prepare functional documentation, configuration documents, and user guides.
Perform system testing, UAT, and support deployment activities.
Provide end-user training and post-implementation support.
Recommend process improvements and system optimization opportunities.
5–7 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations.
Strong functional knowledge of HR and Payroll modules.
Proven experience in HR module customizations and enhancements.
Good understanding of HR appraisal and performance management processes.
Experience with workflows, configurations, reports, and system integrations.
Understanding of D365 F&O technical architecture, X++, and data entities.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
Ability to work directly with HR stakeholders and translate business requirements into system solutions.
Previous experience implementing HR and Payroll solutions in the UAE or GCC.
Knowledge of UAE/GCC payroll requirements and labor regulations.
r: Configure, implement, and support the HR and Payroll modules in Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O.
Manage core HR functionalities, including employee management, organizational structures, positions, departments, and personnel administration.
Handle payroll configurations, salary structures, allowances, deductions, benefits, and payroll processing.
Understand and support end-to-end HR and payroll business processes.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into functional and technical specifications.
Have hands-on experience with HR module customizations and enhancements in Dynamics 365 F&O.
Work on custom fields, forms, workflows, reports, and system extensions.
Coordinate with technical teams on X++, integrations, data entities, and reporting requirements.
Troubleshoot system issues and provide technical and functional support.
